dedupe_keys.name: tdp nw benchmark instances for the train dispatching problem with no wait constraints

description: Luka Stärk at Freie Universität Berlin publishes benchmark instances for train dispatching with no-wait constraints. One archive contains 32 instances from three German dispatching regions, derived from DB InfraGO data and covering planning horizons of 20, 40, 60 and 90 minutes. A second archive adapts DISPLIB instances. JSON records represent trains as directed acyclic graphs of operations, resource reservations, release offsets, time bounds and delay costs. Time offsets use whole seconds. These inputs support optimisation benchmarks and microscopic railway-operation simulations. The August 2026 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Train and infrastructure identities are anonymised, and objective thresholds are normalised; the data cannot reconstruct the named operating locations. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The public format documentation was read, but no instance archive or solver was executed.
